brief.headline: Binance has covered 90% of losses from $6.3 billion hack
brief.detail: Binance says it has covered 90% of losses from the $6.3 billion hack so far, which the FT describes as the world's biggest heist.

brief.headline: US stocks slide as Amazon, Intel earnings spark AI selling
brief.detail: Amazon and Intel earnings triggered more selling over AI spending concerns, pushing US stocks lower.

brief.headline: OpenAI cuts fundraising goal to up to $20 billion
brief.detail: OpenAI is now seeking up to $20 billion in its latest round, which is still in progress and has not closed, so figures may change.
